name: lbdc-platform
description: LB Digital Creations — Complete Production-Ready Digital Celebration SaaS Platform

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web && npm run build:admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix packages/shared && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/api && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/web && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/api && npm run lint --prefix apps/web && npm run lint --prefix apps/admin
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix packages/shared && npm run test --prefix apps/api
